title: Invertibility of the ambient canonical open coefficient mate
statement: For a prime l, finite coefficient extension E, normalized operation data o, any open immersion j:U→X and any object K of the unbounded derived category of completed coefficient modules on U, the component at K of the inverse open-adjunction mate of the normalized reductionPull square is invertible. The comparison is the specified openReduction, not an arbitrary isomorphism. The normalized operation models are those of [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge] and the typed-word domain is that of [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]; the operation data, finite words, generator kinds, admissibility predicates and the coefficient-square Assertion are those of [def-sf-generator-reduction-data].

source.place: Maps-used sentence; open-adjunction and four-factor clopen expansion of lem-sf-open-interchange-reduction-squares.

proof.text: Present the input on the good localization of the integral derived category. The mate localization lemma identifies, up to isomorphisms, the component of the specified openReduction at a good representative with the localization of the ordinary open reduction complex map; that complex map is degreewise invertible by the ordinary open-mate invertibility, hence invertible, and so is the component. This is the first half of the open reconstruction effectivity argument, which uses no hypothesis on the input; the Lean proof applies its proof (fixedOpenReduction_isIso) to o.system and o.realization.
